correctness.rationale: Reconstructed depth-0 labels and neighbor type set recurrence, where degree-two regularity makes the set equivalent to the unordered pair with multiplicities. Verified local centered substring up-to-reversal reconstruction independently on all binary words length <=13 and ternary words length <=9, plus the supplied full verifier for arbitrary cyclic words. In the half-cycle argument an aligned dihedral map leaves at most one omitted vertex when n even, forced by equal total counts; at odd n the omitted adjacent pair is resolved via reflection or a rotation-step parity argument. This proves the complete all-n bound beyond finite tests. Distinct asymmetric primitive bracelets exactly characterize intercomponent separation by doubly-infinite periodic words; free dihedral orbit count 2n gives product formula. For n<=5 every binary coloring has a nontrivial stabilizer.
residual_risks: The sharp cycle depth does not extend to arbitrary disconnected frames; intercomponent depth can be larger.
The lemma and group arguments are written proofs, backed but not replaced by finite verifier.
